description: This Python source file defines the DailySpendUpdateQueue class, which manages an in-memory queue of daily spend update transactions. It provides methods for adding updates, aggregating queued transactions, and retrieving aggregated data, typically used for efficiently handling database updates related to user or team spending metrics.

classes.name: DailySpendUpdateQueue
classes.description: A class that manages an in-memory queue for daily spend updates, providing mechanisms to add, aggregate, and retrieve transaction data efficiently, used primarily to prepare batch updates to a database.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the queue by calling the superclass constructor and setting up an asyncio queue for daily spend transactions.

methods.name: add_update
methods.description: Enqueues a new daily spend update transaction into the internal asyncio queue; triggers aggregation if maximum size is reached.

methods.name: aggregate_queue_updates
methods.description: Aggregates all current updates in the queue into a single summarized transaction to reduce size.

methods.name: flush_and_get_aggregated_daily_spend_update_transactions
methods.description: Retrieves all updates from the queue, aggregates them by transaction key, and returns the result.

methods.name: get_aggregated_daily_spend_update_transactions
methods.description: Static method that takes a list of update dictionaries and merges transactions with the same key, summing their metrics.

methods.name: _emit_new_item_added_to_queue_event
methods.description: Asynchronously logs an event indicating a new item has been added to the queue, for monitoring purposes.
